Cholesterol uptake via low-density lipoprotein (LDL) complexes occurs through receptor-mediated endocytosis. This process involves cell-surface receptors (LDL receptors), endosome formation after vesicle internalization, and eventual release of cholesterol into the cell. Adhesion plaques, however, are structures involved in cell–matrix adhesion and signaling, not in endocytosis or cholesterol uptake.
